title: Mara Vale
design_statement: Practical intelligence meets conflicting explanations.
gameplay_hook: Notice patterns, work with tools, ask questions, revise conclusions.
pressure_or_tradeoff: Belonging and independence can both carry real cost.

title: Abel Vale
design_statement: A gifted mechanic whose certainty can become control.
gameplay_hook: Advanced repair, machinery access, preparation knowledge, restricted spaces.
pressure_or_tradeoff: Approval can increase risk and reduce room for dissent.

title: Ruth Vale
design_statement: A healer and entrepreneur who can be decisive in crisis and evasive at home.
gameplay_hook: Herbal preparation, first aid, community visitors, Mercy House access.
pressure_or_tradeoff: Care and denial can exist in the same relationship.

title: Jonah Vale
design_statement: Order, music, study, and the first credible path outward.
gameplay_hook: Teaching, library access, academic help, patient problem solving.
pressure_or_tradeoff: Leaving can look like betrayal to people who love him.

title: Silas Vale
design_statement: Skill and charm sit beside volatility and control.
gameplay_hook: Climbing, difficult routes, risky work, social access.
pressure_or_tradeoff: Intimacy never guarantees safety or accountability.

title: Eliza Vale
design_statement: She notices contradictions before she is ready to act on them.
gameplay_hook: Household memory, logistics, quiet corroboration, private access.
pressure_or_tradeoff: Recognition and action can diverge.

title: Nora Vale
design_statement: A blunt outside option who makes leaving feel possible and costly.
gameplay_hook: Rides, town access, practical advice, family history.
pressure_or_tradeoff: Help can become pressure when urgency overrides listening.

title: Caleb Hart
design_statement: Ordinary care and social ease make the outside world less abstract.
gameplay_hook: Radio repair, first aid, town navigation, confidant conversations.
pressure_or_tradeoff: Closeness can survive disagreement or require distance.

title: Dr. Miriam Kline
design_statement: A mentor who expands questions instead of supplying identity.
gameplay_hook: Archive access, source comparison, academic negotiation, historical context.
pressure_or_tradeoff: Recognition helps only when Mara chooses the work.

title: Rev. Isaac Hale
design_statement: Faith appears through care, stewardship, humility, and community responsibility.
gameplay_hook: Meetinghouse access, service tasks, reflective dialogue, moral counterpoint.
pressure_or_tradeoff: Shared faith does not require shared conclusions.

title: Deputy Lena Ortiz
design_statement: Procedure can protect people without becoming perfect or omniscient.
gameplay_hook: Records, emergency response, public responsibility, institutional routes.
pressure_or_tradeoff: Outside help creates paperwork, visibility, and family consequences.

title: Tess Ward
design_statement: A peer equal who tests Mara through work, performance, and competition.
gameplay_hook: Salvage contests, theater tasks, rumors, peer routes.
pressure_or_tradeoff: Rivalry can become respect, exploitation, or distance.

title: Wade Mercer
design_statement: Economic pressure rewards speed and hides risk inside ordinary business.
gameplay_hook: Quarry contracts, money, deadlines, equipment access.
pressure_or_tradeoff: Profit can amplify unsafe family choices without causing every conflict.

title: Vale Homestead
design_statement: Home is a working system and the emotional consequence hub.
gameplay_hook: Chores, meals, private rooms, animals, preparation, family conversations.
pressure_or_tradeoff: Safety, belonging, surveillance, and dependence share the same space.

title: Iron Hollow
design_statement: The salvage yard turns mechanical competence into risk, money, and family status.
gameplay_hook: Repair, salvage, fabrication, loader work, parts economy.
pressure_or_tradeoff: Fast work earns approval while hidden wear can create future danger.

title: Mercy House
design_statement: Care work makes belief and evidence materially consequential.
gameplay_hook: Gather, prepare, observe, document, call for outside help.
pressure_or_tradeoff: Every care choice changes trust, cost, exposure, and uncertainty.

title: Cedar Gate Main Street
design_statement: A one-stoplight town makes reputation visible.
gameplay_hook: Errands, social encounters, rumors, objective navigation.
pressure_or_tradeoff: The town may know the Vale family before Mara speaks.

title: Merritt's Fuel & Post
design_statement: Fuel, mail, gossip, and small commerce share one counter.
gameplay_hook: Buy supplies, hear rumors, check messages, meet passing characters.
pressure_or_tradeoff: Useful information often arrives wrapped in judgment or familiarity.

title: Cedar Gate Opera House
design_statement: Performance creates a public self that family work cannot fully contain.
gameplay_hook: Rehearse, perform, build sets, meet peers, hear town stories.
pressure_or_tradeoff: Visibility can create confidence and family scrutiny.

title: Cedar Gate Carnegie Library
design_statement: Books make unknown worlds physically reachable.
gameplay_hook: Research, browse, compare sources, use indexes, ask a librarian.
pressure_or_tradeoff: New language can clarify experience and expose painful gaps.

title: Ridgeway Hardware
design_statement: A practical store turns evidence into ordinary objects and expert knowledge.
gameplay_hook: Compare parts, ask questions, inspect wear, buy repair supplies.
pressure_or_tradeoff: A shopkeeper's explanation may conflict with Abel's account.

title: Cedar Gate Meetinghouse
design_statement: Faith is social practice, not a morality meter.
gameplay_hook: Service, worship, conversation, community requests, pastoral counsel.
pressure_or_tradeoff: Belonging can support Mara while also increasing social pressure.

title: South Fork
design_statement: Backcountry competence opens routes that roads cannot.
gameplay_hook: Horse travel, herbs, tracking, cabins, river crossings.
pressure_or_tradeoff: Weather and distance turn preparation into meaningful choice.

title: Highline Pass
design_statement: The mountain becomes a navigation problem, weather system, and mystery space.
gameplay_hook: Climb, radio, prepare, shelter, search, retreat.
pressure_or_tradeoff: Curiosity competes with time, weather, and promises made at home.

title: Echo Quarry
design_statement: Industrial work exposes the economics behind risk.
gameplay_hook: Contracts, equipment, hauling, negotiation, safety inspection.
pressure_or_tradeoff: Money can solve household problems while increasing unsafe pressure.

title: Wasatch College South Apartments
design_statement: Private routines reveal invisible social rules.
gameplay_hook: Roommate life, schedules, hygiene, Sabbath expectations, study.
pressure_or_tradeoff: Learning institutional norms can feel like learning a new language.

title: Wasatch College Campus
design_statement: An unfamiliar institution becomes a navigable game space.
gameplay_hook: Registrar, Founders Auditorium, computer lab, Engineering Hall, buses.
pressure_or_tradeoff: Asking for help can save time but expose what Mara does not know.

title: Trinity Great Court
design_statement: Historical scale turns education into embodied place.
gameplay_hook: Find room, follow porter, explore cloister, listen, study.
pressure_or_tradeoff: Expansion creates awe without erasing the pull of home.

title: Repair and Salvage
design_statement: Machines are readable problems rather than button prompts.
gameplay_hook: Inspect, disassemble, compare wear, select tools, fabricate, test.
pressure_or_tradeoff: A faster solution can preserve time and increase hidden risk.

title: Traversal and Weather
design_statement: Movement is planning, observation, and changing conditions.
gameplay_hook: Walk, climb, ride, drive, map routes, read weather.
pressure_or_tradeoff: Shortcuts trade time against exposure, equipment, and trust.

title: Care and Treatment
design_statement: Care is a decision under incomplete information.
gameplay_hook: Observe, gather, prepare, document, ask, call, transport.
pressure_or_tradeoff: Different choices affect health, cost, privacy, and family loyalty.

title: Conversation Intentions
design_statement: Dialogue expresses intent rather than a correct sentence.
gameplay_hook: Ask, challenge, reassure, deflect, joke, remain silent, leave.
pressure_or_tradeoff: The same words can land differently based on history and timing.

title: Relationships
design_statement: Relationships hold several states at once.
gameplay_hook: Build trust, earn respect, create dependence, reduce fear, test loyalty, gain clarity.
pressure_or_tradeoff: Agreement can increase access while reducing self-trust or respect.

title: Worldview Profiles
design_statement: Beliefs shape what characters notice and how they explain events.
gameplay_hook: Learn values through behavior, stories, work, worship, records, and conflict.
pressure_or_tradeoff: Understanding a worldview does not require agreeing with it.

title: Evidence and Memory
design_statement: Truth is assembled from observation, testimony, records, and interpretation.
gameplay_hook: Collect, compare, annotate, revise, leave uncertainty open.
pressure_or_tradeoff: A stronger conclusion can still damage a relationship.

title: Home Consequence Hub
design_statement: The world returns to breakfast, supper, chores, and private rooms.
gameplay_hook: Face rumors, changed resources, broken promises, new access, new silence.
pressure_or_tradeoff: A good outside outcome can create a difficult home consequence.

title: Time Routine and Resources
design_statement: Days have work blocks, open hours, meals, and night reflection.
gameplay_hook: Choose tasks, spend favors, use parts, manage fatigue, respond to weather.
pressure_or_tradeoff: Doing one useful thing means leaving another thing undone.

title: Capability and Fail Forward
design_statement: Progress expands what Mara can attempt rather than increasing combat power.
gameplay_hook: Grow mechanical skill, fieldcraft, observation, persuasion, history, self-direction, collaboration.
pressure_or_tradeoff: Failure changes the situation and can teach without forcing reload.

title: The Hairline Crack
design_statement: A small mechanical clue challenges authority before a crisis exists.
gameplay_hook: Inspect, reinforce, continue, report, ask for help.
pressure_or_tradeoff: Delay can anger Abel while speed can carry danger forward.

title: Suspended Load
design_statement: The player reads space under pressure and acts before impact.
gameplay_hook: Cut power, stabilize, pull clear, shout.
pressure_or_tradeoff: Who acts first changes later trust and blame.

title: Mercy House Choice
design_statement: Care becomes a conflict between practice, evidence, privacy, and outside help.
gameplay_hook: Prepare, document, ask, call clinic.
pressure_or_tradeoff: The practical choice becomes a family statement.

title: County Road Small Talk
design_statement: A drive turns ordinary conversation into social comparison.
gameplay_hook: Drive, observe, answer, redirect, ask, stop.
pressure_or_tradeoff: An outsider can notice what Mara treats as normal.

title: Hardware Evidence
design_statement: A replacement part becomes physical evidence about the earlier failure.
gameplay_hook: Compare, measure, ask shopkeeper, buy, conceal, report.
pressure_or_tradeoff: Evidence can challenge a family explanation without proving motive.

title: Meetinghouse Counterpoint
design_statement: A familiar faith tradition produces a different ethical conclusion.
gameplay_hook: Listen, serve, ask, disagree, stay after, leave.
pressure_or_tradeoff: Religious belonging becomes more complex rather than simply weaker.

title: Supper Version
design_statement: The family converts the workday into a shared story.
gameplay_hook: Correct, soften, support, remain silent.
pressure_or_tradeoff: The version repeated tonight can shape tomorrow's access and trust.

title: Ridge Signal
design_statement: A distant signal turns curiosity into a route decision.
gameplay_hook: Prepare, investigate, retreat, radio for help.
pressure_or_tradeoff: Following the mystery may break a promise at home.

title: Covenant Protection
design_statement: Safety comes through obedience, separation, preparation, and family unity.
gameplay_hook: Characters value readiness, loyalty, and protection from outside control.
pressure_or_tradeoff: Protection can preserve people or constrict growth.

title: Stewardship Faith
design_statement: Faith is measured through care, humility, repair, and responsibility.
gameplay_hook: Service and practical care become religious actions.
pressure_or_tradeoff: Shared scripture can support different conclusions about duty.

title: Civic Trust
design_statement: Shared evidence and public institutions can protect where private systems fail.
gameplay_hook: Records, procedure, clinics, schools, and county response gain meaning.
pressure_or_tradeoff: Institutions can help while remaining slow, partial, or impersonal.

title: Skeptical Pragmatism
design_statement: Test what works and distrust claims that cannot survive observation.
gameplay_hook: Practical tests and repeatable results guide decisions.
pressure_or_tradeoff: Useful results do not answer every moral or relational question.

title: Scholarly Inquiry
design_statement: Sources, comparison, uncertainty, and revision are forms of strength.
gameplay_hook: Research changes what Mara can notice and name.
pressure_or_tradeoff: Better evidence can increase grief before it creates freedom.

title: Trust
design_statement: Will this person believe Mara's intent or account?
gameplay_hook: Private information, help, warnings, and vulnerability become available.
pressure_or_tradeoff: Trust can remain high while respect or agreement falls.

title: Respect
design_statement: Does this person value Mara's judgment and capability?
gameplay_hook: Others accept plans, tools, boundaries, and expertise.
pressure_or_tradeoff: Compliance can increase trust while decreasing respect.

title: Dependence
design_statement: How much does each person need the other for work, care, money, access, or identity?
gameplay_hook: Shared tasks and resources create practical bonds.
pressure_or_tradeoff: Dependence can preserve connection after affection weakens.

title: Fear
design_statement: What consequence does this person expect from disagreement or loss?
gameplay_hook: Tone, hesitation, avoidance, preparation, and secrecy change.
pressure_or_tradeoff: Fear can coexist with love and loyalty.

title: Loyalty
design_statement: Whose side will this person protect when stories conflict?
gameplay_hook: Characters defend, conceal, corroborate, or distance themselves.
pressure_or_tradeoff: Loyalty can support care or suppress accountability.

title: Clarity
design_statement: How well does Mara understand this person's values, patterns, limits, and contradictions?
gameplay_hook: New dialogue intentions and predictions become possible.
pressure_or_tradeoff: Clarity gives options, not control over another person.

title: Ridge Dawn
design_statement: Home and the outside world compete for attention before the first task.
gameplay_hook: Look, climb down, mark smoke, choose first destination.
pressure_or_tradeoff: Attention itself becomes the first player choice.

title: Breakfast Pressure
design_statement: The workday begins inside a relationship system.
gameplay_hook: Answer, joke, ask about the call, stay silent.
pressure_or_tradeoff: The response changes tone before the yard tutorial starts.

title: Hairline Crack
design_statement: Competence and authority conflict around one readable flaw.
gameplay_hook: Inspect, reinforce, continue, call someone over.
pressure_or_tradeoff: The player can trade approval for safety or certainty.

title: Suspended Load
design_statement: Danger arrives through a system the player already understands.
gameplay_hook: Cut power, stabilize, pull clear, shout.
pressure_or_tradeoff: Action changes later accounts of responsibility.

title: Mercy House
design_statement: Care creates a choice without a perfect answer preview.
gameplay_hook: Help Ruth, document, ask, call clinic.
pressure_or_tradeoff: The player acts before knowing every consequence.

title: County Road
design_statement: Movement, observation, and conversation occur at the same time.
gameplay_hook: Drive, choose route, watch weather, talk.
pressure_or_tradeoff: The outside perspective enters through ordinary small talk.

title: Cedar Gate
design_statement: The town is a navigable social space rather than a quest menu.
gameplay_hook: Run errand, visit library, enter opera house, observe locals.
pressure_or_tradeoff: Reputation changes how strangers and acquaintances approach Mara.

title: Supper Version
design_statement: A practical event becomes contested memory at home.
gameplay_hook: Correct, soften, support, stay silent.
pressure_or_tradeoff: The story repeated tonight can become tomorrow's family fact.

title: Memory Journal
design_statement: The player separates observation, testimony, and interpretation.
gameplay_hook: Sort, compare, revise, leave uncertain.
pressure_or_tradeoff: An earlier conclusion remains visible after revision.

title: Ridge Signal
design_statement: Curiosity opens the map and creates a social cost.
gameplay_hook: Prepare, investigate, retreat, radio for help.
pressure_or_tradeoff: Exploration can break a promise or consume needed time.

title: College Threshold
design_statement: Institutional rules become a new exploration problem.
gameplay_hook: Check map, ask student, follow crowd, visit registrar.
pressure_or_tradeoff: Missing knowledge is treated as missing access rather than low intelligence.

title: Wider World
design_statement: The map expands without declaring the earlier world meaningless.
gameplay_hook: Follow porter, find room, explore cloister, stop and listen.
pressure_or_tradeoff: Awe and loss remain present together.
